          OR b.operational_readiness IS DISTINCT FROM 'available'
          OR b.last_evaluated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p.checked_at

          OR r.resource_ref->>'resourceId' IS DISTINCT FROM p.binding_id

          OR r.result_ref->>'resourceId' IS DISTINCT FROM p.binding_id
          OR r.result_ref->>'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM p.binding_version::text
          OR r.resource_ref->>'authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'postgresql'
          OR r.result_ref->>'authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'postgresql'
          OR r.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM p.checked_at

              JOIN public.aip_agent_registry_receipt rc ON rc.org_id=bc.org_id AND rc.project_id=bc.project_id

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER trg_bundle_installation_revision_decision AFTER INSERT ON public.bundle_installation_revision DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ensure_bundle_installation_revision_decision()
application_triggers.source:
DECLARE
          decision_row bundle_installation_decision%ROWTYPE;
        BEGIN
          IF NEW.state IN ('draft', 'submitted') THEN
            IF NEW.decision_id IS NOT NULL THEN
              RAISE EXCEPTION
                'pre-decision revision cannot reference a decision'
                USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
            RETURN NULL;
          END IF;
          SELECT * INTO decision_row
            FROM bundle_installation_decision
           WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id
             AND project_id = NEW.project_id
             AND decision_id = NEW.decision_id;
          IF NOT FOUND
             OR decision_row.installation_pk IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.installation_pk
             OR decision_row.lock_hash IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.lock_hash
             OR decision_row.permission_diff_hash IS DISTINCT FROM
                  NEW.permission_diff_hash
             OR decision_row.migration_plan_hash IS DISTINCT FROM
                  NEW.migration_plan_hash
             OR decision_row.contribution_diff_hash IS DISTINCT FROM
                  NEW.contribution_diff_hash
             OR (
               NEW.state = 'rejected' AND decision_row.decision <> 'rejected'
             )
             OR (
               NEW.state IN ('approved', 'applied', 'active', 'rolled_back')
               AND decision_row.decision <> 'approved'
             ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
              'installation revision decision lineage is invalid'
              USING ERRCODE = '23514';
          END IF;
          IF NEW.state IN ('approved', 'rejected')
             AND NOT (NEW.state = 'approved' AND EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM bundle_installation_revision p
               WHERE p.org_id=NEW.org_id AND p.project_id=NEW.project_id
                 AND p.installation_pk=NEW.installation_pk AND p.revision=NEW.parent_revision
                 AND p.state='applied' AND p.decision_id=NEW.decision_id))
             AND decision_row.submitted_revision IS DISTINCT FROM
                  NEW.parent_revision THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
              'installation decision is not bound to submitted parent'
              USING ERRCODE = '23514';
          END IF;
          RETURN NULL;
        END;

application_triggers.source:
DECLARE v_phase text;
      BEGIN
        v_phase:=CASE
          WHEN NEW.kind='activate' AND NEW.status='draining' THEN 'pause'
          WHEN NEW.kind='activate' AND NEW.status='committed' THEN 'commit'
          WHEN NEW.kind='activate' AND NEW.status='validated' THEN 'validate'
          WHEN NEW.kind='activate' AND NEW.status='resumed' THEN 'resume'
          WHEN NEW.kind='rollback' AND NEW.status='draining' THEN 'fence'
          WHEN NEW.kind='rollback' AND NEW.status='rolled_back' THEN 'rollback'
          ELSE NULL END;
        IF v_phase IS NOT NULL AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.extension_dispatch_cutover_receipt r
            WHERE r.org_id=NEW.org_id AND r.project_id=NEW.project_id
              AND r.cutover_operation_id=NEW.cutover_operation_id AND r.phase=v_phase)
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '% cutover requires % Receipt',NEW.status,v_phase
          USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END

        old_ref jsonb; new_ref jsonb; prior_ref jsonb; expected jsonb; m record; n integer:=0;
        start_at timestamptz;end_at timestamptz;prior_definition_revision bigint;prior_definition_hash text;
        transferred boolean:=false;
        transfer_steps integer:=0;
    BEGIN
        old_ref=jsonb_build_object('resourceType','SnapshotScheduleDefinitionRevision',
            'resourceId','snapshot-schedule-'||NEW.definition_id::text,
            'revision',NEW.original_definition_revision,'contentHash',NEW.original_definition_hash);
        new_ref=jsonb_build_object('resourceType','SnapshotScheduleDefinitionRevision',
            'resourceId','snapshot-schedule-'||NEW.definition_id::text,
            'revision',NEW.current_definition_revision,'contentHash',NEW.current_definition_hash);
        prior_ref=CASE WHEN NEW.revision=1 THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object(
            'resourceType','SnapshotGroupRecoveryRevision','resourceId','snapshot-recovery-'||NEW.group_id::text,
            'revision',NEW.previous_revision,'contentHash',NEW.previous_hash) END;
        expected=jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','aos.snapshot-group-recovery/v1','mode','saved-input-only',
            'orgId',NEW.org_id,'projectId',NEW.project_id,'groupId',NEW.group_id::text,'revision',NEW.revision,
            'priorRef',prior_ref,'originalDefinitionRef',old_ref,'currentDefinitionRef',new_ref,
            'originalScheduleClaimHash',NEW.original_schedule_hash,'originalSourceClaimHash',NEW.original_source_hash,
            'inputManifestHash',NEW.input_manifest_hash,'actor',NEW.actor,'executor',NEW.executor,
            'policyRef',NEW.policy_ref,'requestHash',NEW.request_hash,'createdAt',NEW.body->'createdAt');
        IF (NEW.body=expected AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.body->'createdAt')='string'
            AND (NEW.body->>'createdAt')::timestamptz=NEW.created_at
            AND NEW.created_at<=clock_timestamp()
            AND public.canonical_bundle_control_sha256(NEW.body)=NEW.content_hash
            AND public.canonical_bundle_control_sha256(NEW.request)=NEW.request_hash
            AND NEW.request->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-group-recovery-request/v1'
            AND NEW.request->>'orgId'=NEW.org_id AND NEW.request->>'projectId'=NEW.project_id
            AND NEW.request->>'groupId'=NEW.group_id::text AND NEW.request->>'actor'=NEW.actor
            AND NEW.request->'expectedRecoveryRef'=prior_ref
            AND NEW.request->>'inputManifestHash'=NEW.input_manifest_hash
            AND NEW.request-ARRAY['schemaVersion','orgId','projectId','groupId','actor','expectedDefinitionRef',
                'expectedRecoveryRef','inputManifestHash','notBefore','expiresAt']='{}'::jsonb
            AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.request->'notBefore')='string' AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.request->'expiresAt')='string') IS NOT TRUE THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot recovery receipt shape or hash differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
        END IF;
        start_at=(NEW.request->>'notBefore')::timestamptz;end_at=(NEW.request->>'expiresAt')::timestamptz;
        IF NOT (end_at>start_at AND end_at-start_at<=interval '24 hours') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot recovery execution window differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
        END IF;
        IF NEW.revision>1 THEN
            SELECT current_definition_revision,current_definition_hash
                INTO STRICT prior_definition_revision,prior_definition_hash
                FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_group_recovery_receipt
                WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND group_id=NEW.group_id AND revision=NEW.previous_revision;
            IF NEW.current_definition_revision<=prior_definition_revision THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot recovery definition history must advance' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
        END IF;
        SELECT * INTO STRICT original FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_revision
            WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND definition_id=NEW.definition_id AND revision=NEW.original_definition_revision;
        SELECT * INTO STRICT renewed FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_revision
            WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND definition_id=NEW.definition_id AND revision=NEW.current_definition_revision;
        transferred=(original.installation_id,original.generation)<>(renewed.installation_id,renewed.generation);
        IF transferred THEN
            SELECT * INTO STRICT transferred_revision FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_revision
                WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND definition_id=NEW.definition_id
                  AND revision=renewed.previous_revision;
            IF ((transferred_revision.installation_id,transferred_revision.generation)=
                    (renewed.installation_id,renewed.generation)) IS NOT TRUE THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot replacement transfer target differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
            LOOP
                transfer_steps=transfer_steps+1;
                IF transfer_steps>renewed.revision-original.revision THEN
                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot replacement transfer chain does not terminate' USING ERRCODE='23514';
                END IF;
                SELECT * INTO STRICT transfer_predecessor FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_revision
                    WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND definition_id=NEW.definition_id
                      AND revision=transferred_revision.previous_revision
                      AND content_hash=transferred_revision.previous_hash;
                IF (transferred_revision.state='disabled' AND transfer_predecessor.state='disabled'
                    AND transferred_revision.previous_revision=transferred_revision.revision-1
                    AND transferred_revision.request->>'orgId'=NEW.org_id
                    AND transferred_revision.request->>'projectId'=NEW.project_id
                    AND transferred_revision.request->>'definitionId'=NEW.definition_id::text
                    AND transferred_revision.request->>'actor'=NEW.actor
                    AND transferred_revision.request->>'intent'='transfer_saved_recovery'
                    AND transferred_revision.request->'settings'='null'::jsonb
                    AND transferred_revision.request->'expectedRef'=transferred_revision.body->'priorRef'
                    AND transferred_revision.request->'transfer'->>'groupId'=NEW.group_id::text
                    AND transferred_revision.request->'transfer'->'expectedRecoveryRef'=prior_ref
                    AND transferred_revision.request-ARRAY['orgId','projectId','definitionId','actor','intent',
                        'expectedRef','settings','transfer']='{}'::jsonb) IS NOT TRUE THEN
                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot replacement transfer authority differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
                END IF;
                IF (transfer_predecessor.revision,transfer_predecessor.content_hash)=
                        (prior_definition_revision,prior_definition_hash) THEN
                    EXIT;
                END IF;
                IF transfer_predecessor.request->>'intent'='disable' THEN
                    SELECT * INTO STRICT disable_predecessor
                        FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_revision
                        WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND definition_id=NEW.definition_id
                          AND revision=transfer_predecessor.previous_revision
                          AND content_hash=transfer_predecessor.previous_hash;
                    IF (transfer_predecessor.state='disabled' AND disable_predecessor.state='enabled'
                        AND transfer_predecessor.previous_revision=transfer_predecessor.revision-1
                        AND (transfer_predecessor.installation_id,transfer_predecessor.generation)=
                            (disable_predecessor.installation_id,disable_predecessor.generation)
                        AND transfer_predecessor.request->>'orgId'=NEW.org_id
                        AND transfer_predecessor.request->>'projectId'=NEW.project_id
                        AND transfer_predecessor.request->>'definitionId'=NEW.definition_id::text
                        AND transfer_predecessor.request->>'actor'=NEW.actor
                        AND transfer_predecessor.request->>'intent'='disable'
                        AND transfer_predecessor.request->'settings'='null'::jsonb
                        AND transfer_predecessor.request->'expectedRef'=transfer_predecessor.body->'priorRef'
                        AND transfer_predecessor.request-ARRAY['orgId','projectId','definitionId','actor','intent',
                            'expectedRef','settings']='{}'::jsonb
                        AND transfer_predecessor.body->'members'=disable_predecessor.body->'members'
                        AND transfer_predecessor.body->>'executor'=disable_predecessor.body->>'executor'
                        AND transfer_predecessor.body->'policyRef'=disable_predecessor.body->'policyRef'
                        AND transfer_predecessor.body->>'cron'=disable_predecessor.body->>'cron'
                        AND transfer_predecessor.body->>'timezone'=disable_predecessor.body->>'timezone'
                        AND (disable_predecessor.revision,disable_predecessor.content_hash)=
                            (prior_definition_revision,prior_definition_hash)) IS NOT TRUE THEN
                        RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot replacement disable bridge differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
                    END IF;
                    EXIT;
                END IF;
                transferred_revision=transfer_predecessor;
            END LOOP;
        END IF;
        SELECT * INTO STRICT claim FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_claim
            WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND group_id=NEW.group_id;
        SELECT * INTO STRICT source_claim FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_group_claim
            WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND group_id=NEW.group_id;
        SELECT * INTO STRICT saved FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_group_input
            WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND group_id=NEW.group_id;
        IF (claim.record->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v2'
            AND claim.content_hash=NEW.original_schedule_hash AND claim.request->'definitionRef'=old_ref
            AND claim.actor=NEW.executor AND source_claim.actor=NEW.executor AND source_claim.member_count=12
            AND saved.request_hash=NEW.original_source_hash AND source_claim.request_hash=NEW.original_source_hash
            AND saved.manifest_hash=NEW.input_manifest_hash AND saved.read_completed_at<=NEW.created_at
            AND public.canonical_bundle_control_sha256(saved.manifest)=saved.manifest_hash
            AND original.state='enabled' AND renewed.state='enabled'
            AND ((original.installation_id,original.generation)=(renewed.installation_id,renewed.generation) OR transferred)
            AND original.body->>'executor'=NEW.executor AND renewed.body->>'executor'=NEW.executor
            AND ((NOT transferred AND original.body->'policyRef'=NEW.policy_ref)
                OR (transferred
                    AND original.body->'policyRef'->>'resourceType'=NEW.policy_ref->>'resourceType'
                    AND original.body->'policyRef'->>'resourceId'=NEW.policy_ref->>'resourceId'))
            AND renewed.body->'policyRef'=NEW.policy_ref
            AND original.body->'cron'=renewed.body->'cron' AND original.body->'timezone'=renewed.body->'timezone'
            AND renewed.request->>'intent'='renew_saved_group'
            AND renewed.body->'priorRef'=NEW.request->'expectedDefinitionRef') IS NOT TRUE THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot recovery original authority differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
        END IF;
        FOR m IN SELECT om.schedule_id,ob.pipeline_id AS old_pipeline,nb.pipeline_id AS new_pipeline,
                ob.binding_id AS old_binding_id,nb.binding_id AS new_binding_id,
                ob.revision AS old_binding_revision,nb.revision AS new_binding_revision,
                ob.actor AS old_actor,nb.actor AS new_actor,
                oc.control_id AS old_control_id,nc.control_id AS new_control_id,
                oc.revision AS old_control_revision,nc.revision AS new_control_revision,
                oc.selection_id AS old_selection_id,nc.selection_id AS new_selection_id,
                oc.selection_revision AS old_selection_revision,nc.selection_revision AS new_selection_revision,
                oc.actor AS old_control_actor,nc.actor AS new_control_actor,
                oc.payload->'draft' AS old_draft,nc.payload->'draft' AS new_draft,
                sc.control_id AS source_control_id,sc.control_revision AS source_control_revision,
                sc.control_hash AS source_control_hash,oc.content_hash AS old_control_hash
            FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_member om
            JOIN public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_member nm
                ON (nm.org_id,nm.project_id,nm.definition_id,nm.schedule_id)=(om.org_id,om.project_id,om.definition_id,om.schedule_id)
                AND nm.revision=NEW.current_definition_revision
            JOIN public.pipeline_schedule_control_binding ob
                ON (ob.org_id,ob.project_id,ob.schedule_id,ob.binding_id,ob.revision,ob.content_hash)=
                   (om.org_id,om.project_id,om.schedule_id,om.binding_id,om.binding_revision,om.binding_hash)
            JOIN public.pipeline_schedule_control_binding nb
                ON (nb.org_id,nb.project_id,nb.schedule_id,nb.binding_id,nb.revision,nb.content_hash)=
                   (nm.org_id,nm.project_id,nm.schedule_id,nm.binding_id,nm.binding_revision,nm.binding_hash)
            JOIN public.pipeline_runtime_control_revision oc
                ON (oc.org_id,oc.project_id,oc.control_id,oc.revision,oc.content_hash)=
                   (ob.org_id,ob.project_id,ob.control_id,ob.control_revision,ob.control_hash)
            JOIN public.pipeline_runtime_control_revision nc
                ON (nc.org_id,nc.project_id,nc.control_id,nc.revision,nc.content_hash)=
                   (nb.org_id,nb.project_id,nb.control_id,nb.control_revision,nb.control_hash)
            JOIN public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_member sm
                ON (sm.org_id,sm.project_id,sm.schedule_id,sm.binding_id,sm.binding_revision,sm.binding_hash)=
                   (om.org_id,om.project_id,om.schedule_id,om.binding_id,om.binding_revision,om.binding_hash)
                AND sm.group_id=NEW.group_id
            JOIN public.pipeline_snapshot_group_member gm
                ON (gm.org_id,gm.project_id,gm.group_id,gm.run_id)=(sm.org_id,sm.project_id,sm.group_id,sm.run_id)
            JOIN public.pipeline_controlled_source_claim sc
                ON (sc.org_id,sc.project_id,sc.run_id)=(gm.org_id,gm.project_id,gm.run_id)
            WHERE om.org_id=NEW.org_id AND om.project_id=NEW.project_id
                AND om.definition_id=NEW.definition_id AND om.revision=NEW.original_definition_revision
        LOOP
            n=n+1;
            IF (m.old_pipeline=m.new_pipeline
                AND m.old_actor=NEW.executor AND m.new_actor=NEW.executor
                AND m.old_control_actor=NEW.executor AND m.new_control_actor=NEW.executor
                AND ((NOT transferred AND m.old_binding_id=m.new_binding_id
                    AND m.new_binding_revision>m.old_binding_revision
                    AND m.old_control_id=m.new_control_id AND m.new_control_revision>m.old_control_revision
                    AND m.old_selection_id=m.new_selection_id AND m.new_selection_revision>m.old_selection_revision
                    AND m.old_draft-ARRAY['notBefore','expiresAt','sourceSelectionRef']=
                        m.new_draft-ARRAY['notBefore','expiresAt','sourceSelectionRef'])
                  OR (transferred
                    AND m.new_draft->'installationRef'->>'installationId'=renewed.installation_id::text
                    AND m.new_draft->>'generation'=renewed.generation::text
                    AND m.old_draft-ARRAY['notBefore','expiresAt','sourceSelectionRef','installationRef',
                        'generation','executionEpoch','configurationRef','packageRef','mappingRef','schemaRef','maskingPolicyRef']=
                        m.new_draft-ARRAY['notBefore','expiresAt','sourceSelectionRef','installationRef',
                        'generation','executionEpoch','configurationRef','packageRef','mappingRef','schemaRef','maskingPolicyRef']
                    AND (m.old_draft->'mappingRef')- 'revision'=(m.new_draft->'mappingRef')- 'revision'
                    AND (m.old_draft->'schemaRef')- 'revision'=(m.new_draft->'schemaRef')- 'revision'
                    AND (m.old_draft->'maskingPolicyRef')- 'revision'=(m.new_draft->'maskingPolicyRef')- 'revision'))
                AND (m.source_control_id,m.source_control_revision,m.source_control_hash)=
                    (m.old_control_id,m.old_control_revision,m.old_control_hash)
                AND (m.new_draft->>'notBefore')::timestamptz=start_at
                AND (m.new_draft->>'expiresAt')::timestamptz=end_at
                AND start_at>=(m.old_draft->>'notBefore')::timestamptz
                AND end_at>(m.old_draft->>'expiresAt')::timestamptz
                AND (m.old_draft->>'expiresAt')::timestamptz>(m.old_draft->>'notBefore')::timestamptz
                AND (m.old_draft->>'expiresAt')::timestamptz-(m.old_draft->>'notBefore')::timestamptz<=interval '24 hours'
                AND saved.read_started_at>=(m.old_draft->>'notBefore')::timestamptz
                AND saved.read_completed_at<(m.old_draft->>'expiresAt')::timestamptz) IS NOT TRUE THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot recovery member semantics differ' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
        IF n<>12 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot recovery requires twelve original members' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER snapshot_schedule_claim_complete AFTER INSERT ON public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_claim DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_snapshot_schedule_claim_a0v_062()
application_triggers.source:
DECLARE h public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_claim; m record; expected jsonb; n integer; d public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_revision;
    BEGIN
        SELECT * INTO STRICT h FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_claim
            WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND group_id=NEW.group_id;
        SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_member
            WHERE org_id=h.org_id AND project_id=h.project_id AND group_id=h.group_id;
        IF (n=12 AND h.request_hash=public.canonical_bundle_control_sha256(h.request)
            AND h.content_hash=public.canonical_bundle_control_sha256(h.record)
            AND h.record->>'schemaVersion' IN ('aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v1','aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v2')
            AND h.record-ARRAY['schemaVersion','request','members']='{}'::jsonb
            AND h.record->'request'=h.request
            AND jsonb_typeof(h.record->'members')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(h.record->'members')=12
            AND ((h.record->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v1'
                  AND h.request->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-request/v1'
                  AND h.request-ARRAY['schemaVersion','orgId','projectId','groupId','actor','scheduledFor','trigger','members']='{}'::jsonb)
              OR (h.record->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v2'
                  AND h.request->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-request/v2'
                  AND h.request-ARRAY['schemaVersion','orgId','projectId','groupId','actor','scheduledFor','trigger','members','definitionRef']='{}'::jsonb))
            AND h.request->>'orgId'=h.org_id AND h.request->>'projectId'=h.project_id
            AND h.request->>'groupId'=h.group_id::text AND h.request->>'actor'=h.actor
            AND h.request->>'trigger'=h.trigger AND (h.request->>'scheduledFor')::timestamptz=h.scheduled_for
            AND jsonb_typeof(h.request->'members')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(h.request->'members')=12) IS NOT TRUE THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot schedule claim incomplete or hash differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
        END IF;
        IF h.record->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v1' AND EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_member member_row
            JOIN public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_current_member c
            ON (member_row.org_id,member_row.project_id,member_row.schedule_id)=(c.org_id,c.project_id,c.schedule_id)
            WHERE member_row.org_id=h.org_id AND member_row.project_id=h.project_id AND member_row.group_id=h.group_id) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'assigned snapshot schedule requires definition authority' USING ERRCODE='23514';
        END IF;
        IF h.record->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v2' THEN
            SELECT r.* INTO d FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_revision r
                JOIN public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_head x
                ON (r.org_id,r.project_id,r.definition_id,r.revision,r.content_hash)=
                   (x.org_id,x.project_id,x.definition_id,x.revision,x.content_hash)
                WHERE r.org_id=h.org_id AND r.project_id=h.project_id
                  AND 'snapshot-schedule-'||r.definition_id::text=h.request->'definitionRef'->>'resourceId';
            IF (d.state='enabled' AND h.request->'definitionRef'=jsonb_build_object(
                    'resourceType','SnapshotScheduleDefinitionRevision',
                    'resourceId','snapshot-schedule-'||d.definition_id::text,
                    'revision',d.revision,'contentHash',d.content_hash)
                    AND d.body->>'executor'=h.actor AND d.body->'members'=h.request->'members') IS NOT TRUE THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot schedule definition authority differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
            SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_current_member
                WHERE org_id=h.org_id AND project_id=h.project_id
                  AND definition_id=d.definition_id AND revision=d.revision;
            IF n<>12 THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot definition current membership incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
        END IF;
        FOR m IN SELECT x.*,b.pipeline_id,b.control_id,b.control_revision,b.control_hash,b.actor,
                r.schedule_id AS run_schedule,r.scheduled_for AS run_slot,r.trigger AS run_trigger
            FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_member x
            JOIN public.pipeline_schedule_control_binding b ON (b.org_id,b.project_id,b.schedule_id,b.binding_id,b.revision,b.content_hash)=
                (x.org_id,x.project_id,x.schedule_id,x.binding_id,x.binding_revision,x.binding_hash)
            JOIN public.meta_schedule_run r ON (r.org_id,r.project_id,r.id)=(x.org_id,x.project_id,x.run_id)
            WHERE x.org_id=h.org_id AND x.project_id=h.project_id AND x.group_id=h.group_id ORDER BY x.ordinal
        LOOP
            expected=jsonb_build_object('scheduleId',m.schedule_id,'pipelineId',m.pipeline_id,
                'bindingRef',jsonb_build_object('resourceType','PipelineScheduleControlBinding',
                    'resourceId','schedule-control-'||m.binding_id::text,'revision',m.binding_revision,'contentHash',m.binding_hash),
                'controlRef',jsonb_build_object('resourceType','PipelineRuntimeControlRevision',
                    'resourceId','pipeline-control-'||m.control_id::text,'revision',m.control_revision,'contentHash',m.control_hash));
            IF (m.actor=h.actor AND m.run_schedule=m.schedule_id AND m.run_slot=h.scheduled_for AND m.run_trigger=h.trigger
                AND h.request->'members'->(m.ordinal-1)=expected
                AND h.record->'members'->(m.ordinal-1)=expected||jsonb_build_object('runId',m.run_id)) IS NOT TRUE THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot schedule member differs from original binding or run' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
        RETURN NEW;
    END

application_triggers.source:
DECLARE h public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_claim; m record; expected jsonb; n integer; d public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_revision;
    BEGIN
        SELECT * INTO STRICT h FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_claim
            WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND group_id=NEW.group_id;
        SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_member
            WHERE org_id=h.org_id AND project_id=h.project_id AND group_id=h.group_id;
        IF (n=12 AND h.request_hash=public.canonical_bundle_control_sha256(h.request)
            AND h.content_hash=public.canonical_bundle_control_sha256(h.record)
            AND h.record->>'schemaVersion' IN ('aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v1','aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v2')
            AND h.record-ARRAY['schemaVersion','request','members']='{}'::jsonb
            AND h.record->'request'=h.request
            AND jsonb_typeof(h.record->'members')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(h.record->'members')=12
            AND ((h.record->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v1'
                  AND h.request->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-request/v1'
                  AND h.request-ARRAY['schemaVersion','orgId','projectId','groupId','actor','scheduledFor','trigger','members']='{}'::jsonb)
              OR (h.record->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v2'
                  AND h.request->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-request/v2'
                  AND h.request-ARRAY['schemaVersion','orgId','projectId','groupId','actor','scheduledFor','trigger','members','definitionRef']='{}'::jsonb))
            AND h.request->>'orgId'=h.org_id AND h.request->>'projectId'=h.project_id
            AND h.request->>'groupId'=h.group_id::text AND h.request->>'actor'=h.actor
            AND h.request->>'trigger'=h.trigger AND (h.request->>'scheduledFor')::timestamptz=h.scheduled_for
            AND jsonb_typeof(h.request->'members')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(h.request->'members')=12) IS NOT TRUE THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot schedule claim incomplete or hash differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
        END IF;
        IF h.record->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v1' AND EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_member member_row
            JOIN public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_current_member c
            ON (member_row.org_id,member_row.project_id,member_row.schedule_id)=(c.org_id,c.project_id,c.schedule_id)
            WHERE member_row.org_id=h.org_id AND member_row.project_id=h.project_id AND member_row.group_id=h.group_id) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'assigned snapshot schedule requires definition authority' USING ERRCODE='23514';
        END IF;
        IF h.record->>'schemaVersion'='aos.snapshot-schedule-claim/v2' THEN
            SELECT r.* INTO d FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_revision r
                JOIN public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_definition_head x
                ON (r.org_id,r.project_id,r.definition_id,r.revision,r.content_hash)=
                   (x.org_id,x.project_id,x.definition_id,x.revision,x.content_hash)
                WHERE r.org_id=h.org_id AND r.project_id=h.project_id
                  AND 'snapshot-schedule-'||r.definition_id::text=h.request->'definitionRef'->>'resourceId';
            IF (d.state='enabled' AND h.request->'definitionRef'=jsonb_build_object(
                    'resourceType','SnapshotScheduleDefinitionRevision',
                    'resourceId','snapshot-schedule-'||d.definition_id::text,
                    'revision',d.revision,'contentHash',d.content_hash)
                    AND d.body->>'executor'=h.actor AND d.body->'members'=h.request->'members') IS NOT TRUE THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot schedule definition authority differs' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
            SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_current_member
                WHERE org_id=h.org_id AND project_id=h.project_id
                  AND definition_id=d.definition_id AND revision=d.revision;
            IF n<>12 THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot definition current membership incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
        END IF;
        FOR m IN SELECT x.*,b.pipeline_id,b.control_id,b.control_revision,b.control_hash,b.actor,
                r.schedule_id AS run_schedule,r.scheduled_for AS run_slot,r.trigger AS run_trigger
            FROM public.pipeline_snapshot_schedule_member x
            JOIN public.pipeline_schedule_control_binding b ON (b.org_id,b.project_id,b.schedule_id,b.binding_id,b.revision,b.content_hash)=
                (x.org_id,x.project_id,x.schedule_id,x.binding_id,x.binding_revision,x.binding_hash)
            JOIN public.meta_schedule_run r ON (r.org_id,r.project_id,r.id)=(x.org_id,x.project_id,x.run_id)
            WHERE x.org_id=h.org_id AND x.project_id=h.project_id AND x.group_id=h.group_id ORDER BY x.ordinal
        LOOP
            expected=jsonb_build_object('scheduleId',m.schedule_id,'pipelineId',m.pipeline_id,
                'bindingRef',jsonb_build_object('resourceType','PipelineScheduleControlBinding',
                    'resourceId','schedule-control-'||m.binding_id::text,'revision',m.binding_revision,'contentHash',m.binding_hash),
                'controlRef',jsonb_build_object('resourceType','PipelineRuntimeControlRevision',
                    'resourceId','pipeline-control-'||m.control_id::text,'revision',m.control_revision,'contentHash',m.control_hash));
            IF (m.actor=h.actor AND m.run_schedule=m.schedule_id AND m.run_slot=h.scheduled_for AND m.run_trigger=h.trigger
                AND h.request->'members'->(m.ordinal-1)=expected
                AND h.record->'members'->(m.ordinal-1)=expected||jsonb_build_object('runId',m.run_id)) IS NOT TRUE THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'snapshot schedule member differs from original binding or run' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
        RETURN NEW;
    END
